verses.english: “One individual, mendicants, arises in the world who is an incredible human being.
The Realized One, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, bhikkhave, ekapuggalo loke uppajjamāno uppajjati acchariyamanusso”ti.
verses.english: This is the one individual, mendicants, who arises in the world who is an incredible human being.”
